empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a named block of review rules that agents reuse. Create one or import a SKILL.md / .zip.

page.selectBody: Pick a skill on the left to edit it, or add a new one.

card.toggle: Enable skill “{name}” for every agent it is attached to
card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: A kebab-case handle: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It becomes the block heading in the prompt.
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill’s interface — write it as a directive: when it applies and what the agent must do. E.g. “When a diff adds a branch, flag it if no test exercises it.”
editor.bodyHint: Rules, checklists, examples. Plain text in the prompt — nothing here is ever executed. Editing the body creates a new version.
editor.enabledHint: Off = left out of every agent’s prompt, but stays attached and keeps its place.
editor.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (max 64).

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: A SKILL.md file or a .zip skill folder. You review everything before it is saved.
import.pickHint: Up to 1 MB. From a .zip only SKILL.md is read — scripts and other files are ignored, never extracted or run.
import.trustBody: An imported skill goes into your agents’ prompts as instructions. It can steer or weaken a review. Read the body below before you enable it.
import.ignoredHint: Not imported, not extracted, not executed.
import.enableHint: Off by default — enable it after you have read the body.

detail.needsVettingTitle: Imported and not enabled yet — read the body before enabling it.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Every body change is kept as an immutable version. Agents always use the current one.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

preview.importedNotice: Imported from a file: these are someone else’s instructions inside your agents’ prompts. Read the body before enabling it.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It is detached from every agent. This cannot be undone.

stats.pullHint: {pulled} of {total} runs of these agents had the skill in the prompt
stats.findingsHint: in runs that used this skill
stats.noAgents: Not attached to any agent yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings in runs with this skill yet.
stats.footnote: Last {days} days, from recorded runs. Findings are counted for runs whose prompt contained this skill — correlation, not proof the skill caused them.
